description: What the user planned and what they actually did over a range: sessions, minutes, distance and vertical gain, planned and completed, the same split per session type, and the sessions themselves. Defaults to the current week (Monday to Sunday) in the user's zone; week_of picks another week, start_date / end_date or days any other range. Distances and vertical gain are in metres (10 km = 10000). Completed totals use what was actually logged and fall back to the plan. A session with no distance adds 0: when sessions_without_distance is there, the distance totals are a floor, not the whole truth. effort covers the completed sessions with an rpe: how many, the mean rpe, and load = rpe × minutes summed (session-RPE load), the number to compare week against week. tag narrows everything to the sessions carrying that tag. All dates are the user's local calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in their own time zone. Requires signing in.

days.description: Days from start_date, when end_date is easier left out.

end_date.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive).

include_sessions.description: False returns the totals only. Default true.

start_date.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD.

tag.description: Only sessions with this tag, e.g. 'hills'. Optional.

week_of.description: Any date (YYYY-MM-DD) inside the week you want.
